description: Route backend capability work to planning or approved implementation while preserving the hard production-write boundary.

modes.intent: Produce the evidence-backed backend brief before product code exists.
selectionFacts: new mutation, query, resolver, handler, module, entity, or projection
exact file and test plan is not approved yet
excludes: implementation of an already approved exact brief
ordinary correction with no new backend capability

modes.intent: Challenge, approve, implement, and prove one exact backend brief.
selectionFacts: owner approval and production implementation requested

stops: approve mode has no exact backend brief
request mixes planning and undisclosed production writes
request requires a different capability owner
